title: Royal Raymond Rife's microscope and frequency machine suppressed
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Royal Raymond Rife's microscope and frequency machine suppressed, about 1930s-1940s at California, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In the 1930s, Reife claimed to have invented a microscope so powerful it could observe live viruses.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of an inventor in California named Royal Raymond Rife, who in the 1930s claimed to have built a microscope so powerful it could watch live viruses. The story, told in an episode about the dark history of the drug industry, holds that Rife's microscope and a machine he built that worked with frequencies were suppressed. If true, it would mean a promising medical invention was buried.
